title: Manner and format of reports required by 247 CMR 20.00
rule_summary: Under 247 CMR 20.01, headed Format of Reports, all reports required by 247 CMR 20.00 shall be made in the manner and format determined by the Board. The provision fixes how the reports that 247 CMR 20.00 requires are made; it does not itself state which events must be reported, which the later sections of 247 CMR 20.00, such as 247 CMR 20.02, address.
exam_relevance: Tests that the manner and format of reports required by 247 CMR 20.00, including reports of improper dispensing and serious adverse drug events under 247 CMR 20.02, are determined by the Board, and that 247 CMR 20.01 addresses how a report is made rather than which events are reportable.

authority.name: Massachusetts Board of Registration in Pharmacy reporting regulations

common_confusions: Reading 247 CMR 20.01 as a list of reportable events, when it provides only that reports required by 247 CMR 20.00 are made in the manner and format determined by the Board.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-17 in the current text of 247 CMR 20.00: Reporting published by the Board of Registration in Pharmacy on mass.gov (the edition dated 12/6/24), 247 CMR 20.01.
